nodes.summary: Executive Order 14448, "Securing American Compute Advantage," was signed in 2027 H1 and takes effect 2027-04-15. It directs Commerce to publish a 15-day fast-track licensing channel for advanced AI accelerators to allied buyers, keeps export controls on frontier-class chips and tooling bound for strategic competitors in force with quarterly review, designates a single federal AI incident desk under EO 14434 to act on any national-security incident within 24 hours including ordering suspension of a deployment where warranted, and affirms federal primacy through one national framework for frontier AI that preempts the emerging patchwork of state laws.

nodes.summary: The American Frontier AI Competitiveness Act is a Discussion Draft (Doc. No. CMT-121-27) before the US Senate Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee, scheduled for markup on 2027-04-22 at 10:00 a.m. in Room 253.
